name: no-self-clone
description: Stops the planner from spawning copies of itself: subagents, forks and workflow agents must run on a cheaper model

mode.title: Enforcement
mode.description: rewrite: move an offending spawn to the worker model. deny: refuse it so the planner retries with an explicit model

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: Model an offending spawn is moved to, when it sits below the planner (else one tier below the planner)
